title: Te Ahi i Kitea Mai i Tawhiti
intro: Whakaarohia tētahi awaawa pōuriuri i te pō, tētahi māramatanga kei tawhiti e pīataata ana i te pae tawhiti, me tētahi kaihaerere takitahi e anga atu ana ki taua māramatanga ki te rapu i te arataki, ā, ka tukuna atu ki a ia tētahi misioni hei tū atu ki tētahi emepaea, hei whakaora hoki i tētahi iwi e tukinotia ana.
clues: I te mea he pēpi ahau, i whakatakotoria ahau ki roto i te pouaka i te taha o te awa i raro i te whakaaweawe a Allah ki tōku whaea.
I whakatipuria ahau i roto i te whare tonu o te kaitukino i tukino i tōku iwi.
I rere ahau i muri i tētahi tautohetohe i mate ai ahau, ā, he maha ngā tau i Madyan e tiaki ana i ngā kahui hipi hei utu.
I kite ahau i tētahi ahi i te taha o te maunga, ā, i karangatia ahau e tētahi reo i te awaawa manaakitanga.
E rua ngā tohu nunui i tukua mai ki ahau i roto i ōku ringa: he tokotoko i huri hei nakahi, me te ringa i kanapa mā.
I tū māua ko tōku tuakana i mua i te rangatira o Ihipa, ā, i muri mai ka kite māua i te moana e pakaru ana hei mawhiti mā māua.
